candidate.answerReason: Time t is the input determining the remaining volume V, so t is the independent variable.

methods.label: Identify the input quantity
methods.explanation: The volume of water $V$ changes as the draining time $t$ changes. Thus, $t$ is the independent variable and $V$ is the dependent variable.
methods.levelReason: Directly identifies independent and dependent variables at Grade 8 level.
